name: TeamStarWolf - Before the Internet: Computer Threats, 1960 to 1990
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified record of computer threats from 1960 to 1990 supports: RFC 1135 on the Morris worm and the Second Circuit opinion, the 1988 and 1989 CERT advisories (CA-1988-01, CA-1989-03, CA-1989-04), RFC 1244 on CA-91:03, RISKS Digest on CHRISTMA EXEC and Lehigh, Virus Bulletin's 1989 and 1990 analyses (nVIR, Disk Killer, the AIDS Information disk), F-Secure's Brain and Jerusalem descriptions, Morris and Thompson's 1979 password study, and the Multics evaluation and Thompson's Turing lecture as Demonstrated cases. The events predate ATT&CK, so every mapping is the study's retrospective reading. Revoked ids map through data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/PRE_INTERNET_THREATS.md. Scores rank the record behind each technique, not severity: 100 a Confirmed primary record describes the behavior, 70 a controlled evaluation or experiment shows it, 40 the id choice is the study's inference.
